title: [storage] Each line of the storage card says from when its own growth is measured
prompt:
Read crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/storage.rs (085's `growth_parts`, each measured from the oldest sample of the last 7 days that carries it; 083's `growth_from` and `growth_from_ms`), crates/spawn-postgres/src/host.rs (`HOST_STORAGE`'s `carrying`), and web/src/resources.ts (`storageView`, its rows, `localDateTime`) and the Storage card (web/src/components/fleet/HealthStrip.tsx).

This comes after objectives 083 (the archive's "measured from") and 085 (a growth part per persistent grower). Both are on the mission's main. If 091 (the forecast's "measured from") or 097 (the session backups' part) is in too, keep them. A part 097 adds (session_backups) gets its moment in growth_from_parts like the others. It has no row on the card, so no line date: while it is pending, 091's forecast date covers it.

The problem (lead-mac, 2026-11-12 17:20, A5). Since 085 each persistent grower is measured from its own oldest sample: the transcript archive, Claude Code's transcripts, the live database (and 097's session backups, which have no row of their own). A part is measured only once its sample is a day old. 083 dates the archive's growth, and 091 dates the forecast as a whole. But a line whose own growth is still pending says nothing about when it will be measured: the database's line after 085's deploy is blank for a day with no date. Each line should carry its own date.

Required behaviour.
(a) `GET /api/fleet`'s `health.storage.growth_from_parts`: for every part of growth_parts, the moment it is first measured.
- That is the at_ms of the oldest sample of the last 7 days that carries the part's field, plus one day (083's rule, per part).
- It is null without such a sample; the archive's is also null without a workspace root.
- The archive's equals 083's growth_from_ms, which stays.
(b) web/src/resources.ts `storageView`: each grower's row carries `measured_from`. The rows are "Transcript archive", "Claude Code transcripts", "Database". A part without a row (097's session backups) gets no line date and no new row.
- While that part's growth is null and its moment is after the sizes' read_at_ms, `measured_from` is the local date and time of its moment (localDateTime, "2026-11-13 07:31"). Otherwise it is null.
- The rows' size and note are unchanged: 065 and 074 pin them.
- The module keeps loading with node alone.
(c) The Storage card shows each line's date beside it ("measured from <date>") while it is set. Read off a screenshot.
No gate, integrator or deploy step reads any of it.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/098.sh. A host.storage sample 30 h old in the old shape (archive and projects) and one 10 h old with the database's size too, over a 3 MiB archive. `spawn serve` answers. Checks:
- (1) growth_from_parts {archive, projects, database}: the archive and the projects at the 30 h sample plus a day, the database at the 10 h sample plus a day. The archive's equals growth_from_ms. The seed: the archive's and the projects' growth measured, the database's null.
- (2) Under node with TZ=Asia/Shanghai, over that answer: the database's row has the local date and time of its moment, and the archive's and the projects' rows have null. A synthetic answer with all three pending (moments a minute apart, an hour after read_at_ms) gives each row its own date ("2026-11-13 07:31", "07:32", "07:33"). Moments already past, or none, give null.
It fails with 1 on 44011cbc (live; 083 is not built there) and on the mission's main 87db3071 (083 and 085 built): no growth_from_parts and no row dates. Its throwaway is on 87db3071 (sync/obj-098/throwaway.diff). A mutant that ignores the read time (it dates a moment already past) fails (2).

Expected on live: the archive's and Claude Code's lines show their growth and no date. While the Database line's growth is pending (its first database_bytes sample is under a day old, as after 085's deploy), that line says "measured from <that sample + 24 h>". Once measured, no line shows a date. growth_from_parts also carries any later part (097's session_backups), which the card dates only through 091's forecast.

The product reason. One blank line on the storage card reads as a fault. A date per line says what is coming and when, on the north star's own inputs. Monitoring only.

Rules: never edit the protected paths, which the gate rejects: rsi/, scripts/ (scripts/rsi/, scripts/blackbox/, scripts/e2e.sh among them), deploy/, all of web/ except web/src/, web/test/ and web/index.html, rust-toolchain files and .cargo/. The gate also rejects fewer runnable tests than the base, any lint relaxation and any build-time code. The gate builds offline from the cargo caches already on the host. Keep every existing check green (065, 074, 083, 084, 085 and 086 read the storage figures) and add tests of your own for the new behaviour:
- a serve/storage unit test of growth_from_parts (a part without a sample, the archive without a root, the archive's equal to growth_from_ms);
- web/test cases of each row's measured_from (pending, measured, past, none).
